faults.title: CPU thermal-interface delamination
faults.repair: authorized cleaning, correct interface pad application and clamping with post-repair thermal verification

faults.title: Fan tachometer stuck-high with partial rotor stall
faults.target: FAN1 fan and J1 tach path
faults.effect: actual airflow reduced while tach falsely reports healthy speed
faults.repair: cross-check thermal response, isolate and replace the defective fan/tach path, rerun load sweep

faults.title: VRM hot-spot via discontinuity
faults.effect: localized VRM temperature rises even with normal CPU temperature
faults.repair: qualify layer span and ground return, perform authorized via rework and repeat load transient test
